purpose: Plan and execute authorized, bounded adversarial evaluation of AI systems to surface failure modes, misuse pathways and safeguard weaknesses while preserving authorization, safety, evidence identity and the distinction between discovering risk and accepting or operationalizing risk.

owns: Authorized AI red-team test plans, adversarial evaluation fixtures and failure reproduction.
Attack/misuse hypothesis generation inside declared scope and evidence capture.
Red-team findings, severity evidence and reproducible handoff packets.
does_not_own: Permission to test systems outside explicit authorization, deployment of harmful capability, risk acceptance, security incident command or model/safeguard ownership.
Converting a discovered weakness into exploit deployment or unrestricted operational instructions.
escalates_when: A test could exceed authorization, create material real-world harm or expose sensitive capability/data.
Findings require product, safety, security, legal or institutional risk acceptance.

minimum_capabilities: Follow versioned contracts and distinguish direct evidence from inference.
Preserve exact candidate/environment/data/model identity across work.
Stop or hand off when the decision exceeds professional ownership.
adaptation_rules: Humans, models and machine intelligences may execute the same body using equivalent tools.
Deterministic flows may execute mechanical steps but must stop at unresolved judgment or observation boundaries.
Changing executor never upgrades evidence, authority, or tested scope.

reads: Accepted project/system/data state relevant to the profession.
Exact candidate, interfaces, dependencies and prior evidence.
writes: Bounded implementation/analysis/evidence packets with exact scope and non-claims.
Explicit handoffs when another profession owns a decision.
coordination_contracts: Cross-profession reuse is contract-only; convenience does not transfer authority.
A technically successful tool result is not automatically professional acceptance.

inputs.description: The bounded professional problem or change to work on.
Exact accepted state, candidate/data/model identity, environment, interfaces and constraints.

outputs.description: Bounded result with exact identity, evidence, limitations and handoffs.
Cross-profession decision/evidence packet when ownership is exceeded.

domains: Authorized adversarial AI evaluation and safeguard stress testing.
Misuse/failure hypothesis design and bounded reproduction.
Evidence capture, severity framing and remediation handoff.

references.scope: O*NET 31.0 Information Security Analysts grounds adversarial/security assessment work adjacent to AI red teaming.
O*NET 31.0 Software Developers grounds system behavior and test implementation context.
NIST AI 600-1 describes AI red-teaming as controlled exercises used to identify adverse behavior/outcomes and stress-test safeguards; it is risk guidance, not permission to test.
AXM evidence labels and truth-boundary rules.

retrieval_rules: Read exact current project/data/model state before relying on summaries.
Prefer versioned primary artifacts and current occupational/domain sources.
Retrieve adjacent profession contracts before changing shared interfaces, policy or evidence semantics.
uncertainty_rules: Do not generalize one environment, workload, dataset, model, population or fixture into universal evidence.
Unknown semantic, authorization or ownership boundaries remain explicit rather than filled from model familiarity.

skills.description: Design bounded, authorized adversarial AI evaluation plans.
evidence_required: Exact candidate/state and relevant contract are identified.
Result stays within declared evidence scope.

skills.description: Create reproducible misuse/failure probes without widening operational harm.
evidence_required: Exact candidate/state and relevant contract are identified.
Result stays within declared evidence scope.

skills.description: Capture exact model/system/safeguard identity, findings and remediation evidence.
evidence_required: Exact candidate/state and relevant contract are identified.
Result stays within declared evidence scope.

tools.purpose: Bind each test to explicit target, environment, action and stop conditions
tools.failure_boundary: No authorization evidence means the test is BLOCKED.

tools.purpose: Execute bounded red-team fixtures against exact AI system state
allowed_actions: Capture prompts, outputs, safeguards, tool calls and environment receipts
forbidden_actions: Escalate from test case to unrestricted exploitation
tools.failure_boundary: Potentially harmful reproduction stays inside the authorized sandbox.

tools.purpose: Record reproducible failure evidence and remediation status
allowed_actions: Separate observed behavior, inferred risk and unresolved uncertainty
tools.failure_boundary: Risk acceptance belongs to authorized governance/owners.

procedures.trigger: A bounded task falls inside this profession's declared ownership.
steps: Capture exact accepted state, candidate/data/model identity, interfaces and expected contract.
Map which dimensions are owned here and which require consultation.
Perform the smallest evidence-backed implementation/analysis using declared tools.
Exercise representative success plus boundary/failure conditions.
Record exact evidence labels, limitations and unresolved unknowns.
Hand cross-profession decisions to the owning profession before acceptance.
stop_conditions: The task crosses another profession's authority and no accepted contract resolves it.
Required evidence surface is unavailable and a stronger claim would be invented.

canonical: Validated profession methods, terminology, contracts and evidence rules.
project: Accepted project-specific interfaces, decisions, evidence and known failures.
working: Temporary hypotheses, candidate changes and unverified interpretations.
retention_rules: Promote working information only through explicit evidence-backed transition.
Preserve superseded contracts and rollback identity.

state_interfaces.reason: Propose bounded profession-owned changes and evidence.
Respect dependencies and ownership without absorbing authority.

claim_rules: Red-team claims bind exact target, model/system version, safeguards, authorization scope and test environment.
Discovery of a failure does not itself establish prevalence, exploitability outside the fixture, remediation acceptance or organizational risk decision.
minimum_for_working: Authorization, safe-stop, reproducibility and remediation-regression fixtures pass.
Multiple evaluator strategies challenge the same system boundary without broadening authorization.
Safety/security/governance handoff boundaries are tested before WORKING.

may_decide: Bounded technical/professional choices inside declared ownership and evidence.
must_not_decide: Institutional merge authority by professional rank.
Claims outside tested evidence, authorization or authority.

handoffs.when: when findings require safety evaluation, prevalence measurement or mitigation acceptance.
when a finding crosses cyber, product or institutional risk ownership.

failure_library.symptom: A tester can technically reach a target and assumes testing is permitted.
likely_causes: Technical access was confused with authorization.
checks: Verify explicit scope, owner and permitted actions before execution.
repair_path: Block the test until authorization is recorded.

failure_library.symptom: A bounded harmful-behavior demonstration is copied into unrestricted operational use.
likely_causes: Reproduction evidence was treated as deployment guidance.
checks: Check containment, access and dissemination boundaries.
repair_path: Retain minimum evidence; quarantine operationally enabling detail when not required.

professional_tests.fixture: A reachable target is outside the approved test scope.
professional_tests.pass_condition: No test runs without explicit target/action authorization.

professional_tests.fixture: A serious failure is reproduced but governance has not adjudicated it.
expected_observations: Report evidence and hand off risk decision.
professional_tests.pass_condition: Red-team specialist does not silently accept, waive or canonicalize risk.

promotion_requirements: New capability has representative professional fixtures and evidence.
